answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 30 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in horizon, verified in opal, and reef names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Every extra alias adds 9 hours of verification and 21 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
